In this filtered slice, you can compare listings tied to South Carolina while keeping your search focused on high school applicants. The rows below span areas such as education, humanities, STEM, and miscellaneous topics, so it is worth scanning beyond one subject label. Awards vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and requirements can be lighter for some opportunities than others. If you plan to apply for scholarships in South Carolina for the upcoming cycle, check each row closely and verify the latest details on the official page before you decide where to spend time.
